positive_evidence: Fast water traversal and swinging between buildings make movement an active core mechanic, matching the profile's established enjoyment of movement and platforming when traversal itself stays engaging.
The game is explicitly story-driven and centers a warm story about loss and reconciliation with a distinct cast, aligning with the profile's recurring interest in narrative and characters.
Its action-adventure structure mixes traversal, exploration and combat rather than relying on passive low-stimulation filler, giving it several plausible hooks for sustained engagement.
